Product Registration and Market Authorisations Timely regulatory approvals are critical for maintaining market access and introducing products across geographies. Delays or changing regulatory requirements may affect business continuity and growth plans. Strengthen regulatory engagement, maintain a diversified registration pipeline, and proactively manage approval timelines across key markets. Negative - Potential delays in revenue realisation, increased compliance expenditure, and restricted access to target markets.

Regulatory and Compliance Management Increasingly stringent regulatory frameworks governing crop protection products and business operations require continuous monitoring and compliance. Enhance compliance oversight, conduct periodic reviews, and strengthen internal controls to ensure adherence to evolving regulations. Negative - Exposure to penalties, legal liabilities, and business disruptions arising from non- compliance.

Supply Chain Efficiency and Continuity A resilient and agile supply chain supports reliable product availability, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction across markets. Strengthen supplier partnerships, optimise inventory planning, and improve visibility across the supply network. Positive - Improved operational performance, stronger customer relationships, and enhanced competitiveness.

Portfolio Development and Innovation Expanding and diversifying the product portfolio enables the Company to address changing customer needs and capture new growth opportunities. Focus on market-driven product introductions, registration expansion, and strategic collaborations. Positive - Increased revenue potential, broader market reach, and improved business resilience.
